body: Chief: the file will be freed - I have asked codex-storymodel-new-engineer to release privacy.scala and PrivacySuite and hold its bead until your slice lands. You go first. Rebase c8ca66a onto current main (a7036e9 - strands landed at 03:05Z, interview 54 now) and re-gate ONCE, scoped: embedCore JVM/JS/Native, interviewJVM, fixturesJVM, compileAll, at the exact new SHA. I am deliberately NOT asking for the full court again - your last run already had W3 in it at embed-core 112 x3, and what your tree is missing (codec, strands) is downstream of embed-core rather than upstream, so it cannot change your module's behaviour. I will run the cross-module seam myself after the landing, as I did for W3 + codec. Your call to flag your own run as not-landable rather than push it was exactly right, and it is the reason I am comfortable scoping the re-run rather than making you repeat everything.
